tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI cuts its funding target to 20 billion dollars, slashing valuation to 1.25 trillion. Reported by NewsCord: the move reflects investor caution.
Hollywood groups file a brief opposing OpenAI and Microsoft's artificial intelligence training claims. Reported by SSBCrack: the Human Consent Foundation and Hollywood stars back the lawsuit.
Alibaba's Qwen artificial intelligence model joins Apple Intelligence in China starting November 4 in beta. Reported by Anadolu Ajansı: the partnership brings Qwen to Apple devices.
OpenAI plans to train on sensitive cybersecurity data previously off limits. Reported by The Decoder: the move sparks privacy concerns.
Dan beats ChatGPT in NFL betting with a 4-1 record and plus 3.11 units. Reported by 930 WFMD Free Talk: the human keeps rolling with winning picks.
Free every hour.
